description: SceneTrees deforming meshes, with f32, quantized, BVH4 and CWBVH nodes and both leaf formats: a cloth refit on the GPU from interleaved vertices, on its GPU tree and then tinybvh's, and rebuilt on the GPU after a held bend drifts it; the GPU walk must match tinybvh trees built from each pose. The cloth's static instance must not merge; the rock's does.
